subject: Linear combinations of part of the linear predictor

messages.author: a6d98ae2ec9c09b9
messages.subject: Linear combinations of part of the linear predictor
parts:
Hello,

I would like to estimate the linear combination of only some terms in the linear predictor and I thought I could use the inla.make.lincomb function to do that.

For example for the following model

n = 100
a = rnorm(n)
b = rnorm(n)
idx = 1:n
df = data.frame(a,b,y)
y = rnorm(n) + a + b
df$a_group <- inla.group(a)
formula = y ~ 1 + f(a_group, model = 'rw2') + b + f(idx, model="iid")

I would like to estimate the linear combination of the intercept + the first two terms:

1 + f(a_group, model = 'rw2') + b

If I try just with the a_group term:

lc1 = inla.make.lincomb(a_group=df$a_group)
r = inla(formula, data = df,
         lincomb = lc1,
         control.family = list(initial=10, fixed=TRUE),
         control.inla = list(lincomb.derived.only=TRUE))

I get the following error

** ERROR **    Lincomb error for section[lincomb.lc]
** ERROR **    [a_group] has length 23, but idx=24 (R-style index) is given


    GMRFLib version 3.0-0-snapshot, has recived error no [9]
    Reason    : Invalid value of parameter
    Message   : Condition `0 == 1' is not TRUE
    Function  : inla_parse_lincomb
    File      : src/inla.c
    Line      : 10799
    RCSId     : hgid: 8b30e851fed2  date: Tue Mar 17 10:38:12 2020 +0300

Am I missing something?

Many thanks,

V

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Linear combinations of part of the linear predictor
parts:
there are several things. first, in the example then

> length(df$a_group)
[1] 100
> length(unique(df$a_group))
[1] 22

so when you're using df$a_group in make. lincomb you're passing in to
long vector, as the length of that component is 22.

secondly, the format of the lincomb, is different, as the indices are
given and you pass the weights (not indices), so if you want the sum of
the rw2, then you would pass

inla.make.lincomb(a_group=rep(1,22))


I attach a modified script

H
